topic: Travmatik kasallik: tushunchasi, davrlari, asosiy komponentlari

slides.title: Kirish: travmatik kasallik nima?

bullets.text: Jarohatdan keyin mahalliy yallig‘lanish har doim bo‘ladi. Og‘ir yoki ko‘p o‘rinli jarohatda unga tizimli yallig‘lanish javobi qo‘shiladi.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

bullets.text: Tizimli javobni gormonal, metabolik va immunologik vositachilar keltirib chiqaradi. U gemodinamik o‘zgarishlar bilan birga kechadi.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

bullets.text: Travma inson to‘qimasi shikastlanishining eng og‘ir shakli. U dunyoda o‘lim va nogironlikning yetakchi sabablaridan biri.

source.author: Vourc'h et al.
source.title: Trauma-Induced Damage-Associated Molecular Patterns-Mediated Remote Organ Injury and Immunosuppression in the Acutely Ill Patient, Frontiers in Immunology

bullets.text: Tizimli javob to‘qima tiklanishi uchun kerak.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

bullets.text: Asoratsiz jarohatda u vaqtinchalik, oldindan taxmin qilinadigan va yallig‘lanishga qarshi vositachilar bilan muvozanatli.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 5 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nima uchun yallig‘lanish javobi organizm uchun foydali? 2) Qaysi holatda u xavfli bo‘lib qoladi? Doskada: ’jarohat → javob → tiklanish’ strelkasini chizdiring. Tipik xato: yallig‘lanishni faqat zararli jarayon deb o‘ylash. Eslatma: manbalarda ’travmatik kasallik’ atamasi o‘rniga ’jarohatga tizimli yallig‘lanish javobi’ ishlatiladi; talabalarga shuni tushuntiring.

slides.title: Mavzuning maqsadi va rejasi

bullets.text: Maqsad: katta jarohatdan keyingi tizimli yallig‘lanish javobining patofiziologiyasini va yakuniy tiklovchi jarrohlik muddatini tushunish.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

bullets.text: Birinchi bo‘limlar: tushuncha va davrlar, so‘ng uchta komponent: gormonal-metabolik, gemodinamik va immunologik javob.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

bullets.text: Keyingi bo‘limlar: DAMPs (zararlanish bilan bog‘liq molekulyar andozalar), uzoq a‘zolar shikasti va jarohatdan keyingi immunosupressiya.

source.author: Vourc'h et al.
source.title: Trauma-Induced Damage-Associated Molecular Patterns-Mediated Remote Organ Injury and Immunosuppression in the Acutely Ill Patient, Frontiers in Immunology

bullets.text: Yakunda qon quyish, ishemiya/reperfuziya (I/R) ta’siri va yakuniy tiklovchi jarrohlikni qachon o‘tkazish masalasi ko‘riladi.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 3 daq. Muhokama: nima uchun jarroh va anesteziolog uchun oddiy javobni bilish muhim? Doskada: ma’ruza rejasini 6 ta bo‘lim ko‘rinishida yozing. Tipik xato: DAMPs ni mikroblar bilan bog‘liq andozalar (PAMPs) bilan adashtirish. Keyinroq farqini alohida ko‘rsating.

slides.title: Tushuncha: mahalliy va tizimli javob

bullets.text: Mahalliy yallig‘lanish har qanday to‘qima jarohatida bo‘ladi.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

bullets.text: Og‘ir yoki ko‘p o‘rinli jarohatda tizimli javob qo‘shiladi.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

bullets.text: Diqqat: mahalliy javob ≠ tizimli javob; ikkinchisining kuchi shikast hajmiga bog‘liq.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 5 daq. Muhokama: 1) Mahalliy javob qachon tizimli javobga aylanadi? 2) Javob kuchi nimaga bog‘liq? Doskada: sxemani o‘zlari chizsin va har strelka ostiga misol yozsin. Tipik xato: har qanday mahalliy yallig‘lanishni tizimli javob deb hisoblash. Tezkor savol: tizimli javob qanday vositachilar bilan boshqariladi?

slides.title: Javobning foydali va xavfli tomonlari

bullets.text: Jarohatda mahalliy yallig‘lanish doim bo‘ladi. Og‘ir yoki ko‘p jarohatda u butun organizmni qamrab oladi va tizimli javobga aylanadi.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

bullets.text: Tizimli yallig‘lanish javobi to‘qima tiklanishi uchun zarur. U sutemizuvchilarda shifo imkoniyatini oshirish uchun shakllangan.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

bullets.text: Asoratsiz jarohatda javob vaqtinchalik va bashorat qilinadi. Yallig‘lanishni kuchaytiruvchi va susaytiruvchi mediatorlar muvozanatda bo‘ladi.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

bullets.text: Diqqat: og‘ir jarohatda boshida haddan oshgan javob kuzatilishi mumkin. Shunda tizimli yallig‘lanish sindromi (SIRS) va a’zolar disfunksiyasi xavfi ortadi.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 5 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nega yallig‘lanish javobi tuzalish uchun kerak? 2) Qaysi holatda u xavfli bo‘lib qoladi? Doskada: ikki ustunli ro‘yxat chizing: «foydasi» va «xavfi (SIRS)». Tipik xato: yallig‘lanish javobini faqat zararli jarayon deb o‘ylash. U tuzalish uchun zarur, xavf esa uning haddan oshishida.

slides.title: Ko‘p zarba nazariyasi

bullets.text: Rejali bemordan farqli, jarohatlangan bemor bir necha zarbaga uchraydi.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

bullets.text: Birinchi zarba — jarohatning o‘zi, ikkinchisi — zarur damage-control jarrohlik.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

bullets.text: Bu zarbalardan so‘ng immun tizim charchab, infeksiya va sepsis xavfi oshishi mumkin.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Muhokama: 1) Rejali jarrohlik bemori jarohatlangan bemordan nimasi bilan farq qiladi? 2) Nega ikkinchi zarba immun tizim uchun xavfli? Doskada: zarbalar zanjirini strelkalar bilan chizing va har zarba tagiga misol yozing. Tipik xato: damage-control jarrohlikni yakuniy tiklovchi jarrohlik bilan adashtirish.

slides.title: Voqea tahlili: bir bemor, ikki zarba

bullets.text: Vaziyat: og‘ir jarohat olgan bemorga birinchi kuni damage-control jarrohlik qilindi, so‘ng u reanimatsiya bo‘limiga (ICU) o‘tkazildi.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

bullets.text: Jarohatdan keyin neytrofillar «priming» (oldindan faollashish) holatiga o‘tadi. Ikkinchi zarba bunday holatda kuchliroq javob berishi mumkin.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

bullets.text: Yakuniy tiklovchi jarrohlik ko‘pincha kechiktiriladi: gipotermiya, atsidoz, koagulopatiya xavfi va immun tizimga yangi zarbadan qochish uchun.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

bullets.text: Savol: yakuniy jarrohlikni qancha kechiktirish kerak? Uch hafta taklif qilingan, lekin bu tasodifiy klinik sinovlarga asoslanmagan.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nega yakuniy jarrohlikni darhol qilmaymiz? 2) Kechiktirishning qanday xavfi bor (beqaror sinish, ARDS)? Doskada: bemorning birinchi kundan 3-haftagacha vaqt chizig‘ini chizing va jarrohlik nuqtalarini belgilang. Tipik xato: kechiktirishni xavfsiz deb hisoblash. Manbada kechiktirishning xavflari ham aytilgan.

slides.title: Tezkor savol 1: tushuncha

bullets.text: Savol: travmada qaysi javob har doim yuzaga keladi — mahalliy yoki tizimli yallig‘lanish javobi? Bir daqiqa o‘ylab ko‘ring.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

bullets.text: Javob: to‘qima travmasida mahalliy yallig‘lanish javobi doim bo‘ladi. Kininlar va gistamin kapillyar o‘tkazuvchanlikni oshirib, shish chaqiradi.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

bullets.text: Og‘ir yoki ko‘p joyli jarohat tizimli yallig‘lanish javobini chaqiradi. Uni gormonal, metabolik va immunologik mediatorlar yuzaga keltiradi.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

bullets.text: Diqqat: xato qilish xavfi — mahalliy javob ≠ tizimli javob. Tizimli javob faqat og‘ir jarohatda rivojlanadi, mahalliysi esa har doim bo‘ladi.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 3 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nega mahalliy javob har doim bo‘ladi, tizimli javob esa yo‘q? 2) Tizimli javobni qaysi mediatorlar chaqiradi? Doskada: ikki doira chizing — kichigi mahalliy, kattasi tizimli — va ichiga mediatorlarni yozing. Tipik xato: talaba har bir jarohatda tizimli yallig‘lanish bo‘ladi deb o‘ylaydi.

slides.title: Davrlar: umumiy ko‘rinish

bullets.text: Gemodinamik javob, metabolik va immunologik javob kabi, ikki fazali: shok va oqim fazalari.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

bullets.text: Metabolizm avval 24 soatgacha pasayadi, so‘ng giper-metabolik, katabolik faza boshlanadi.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

bullets.text: Asoratsiz travmada giper-metabolik faza odatda bir haftadan kam davom etadi.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

items.title: Oqim fazasi
items.text: Vazodilatatsiya, O2 sarfi ↑; asoratsiz bir necha kun

items.title: Gipometabolizm
items.text: Metabolizm sur’ati pasayadi; bir necha soatdan 24 soatgacha

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Muhokama: 1) Oqim fazasi nega giper-metabolik faza deb ham ataladi? 2) Nega bu davrlar ikki fazali deyiladi? Doskada: vaqt o‘qini chizing — chapda shok, o‘ngda oqim fazasi — va metabolik o‘zgarishlarni ostiga yozing. Tipik xato: shok fazasini giper-metabolik faza bilan adashtirish; aslida giper-metabolik faza oqim fazasiga to‘g‘ri keladi.

slides.title: Shok fazasi: gemodinamik o‘zgarishlar

bullets.text: Dastlabki shok fazasida qon ketishi gipovolemiyaga olib keladi va kuchli periferik vazokonstriksiya rivojlanadi.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

bullets.text: Organizm natriy xlorid va suvni ushlab qoladi; qon periferiyadan markaziy hayotiy a’zolarga o‘tadi.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

bullets.text: Reanimatsiya qilinmagan jabrlanuvchida shok fazasi taxminan bir kun davom etgan. Hozir erta infuzion terapiya va qon quyish uni qisqartiradi.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

bullets.text: Diqqat: ko‘pchilik anesteziya vositalari vazodilatatsiya chaqiradi va shok fazasidagi hayotiy muhim vazokonstriksiyaga qarshi ishlaydi.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 5 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nega shok fazasida periferik vazokonstriksiya foydali? 2) Anesteziya vositalari shok fazasida qanday xavf tug‘diradi? Doskada: zanjir chizing — qon ketishi → gipovolemiya → vazokonstriksiya → qonning markazga o‘tishi. Tipik xato: shok fazasidagi vazokonstriksiyani oqim fazasidagi vazodilatatsiya bilan aralashtirish.

slides.title: Oqim (flow) fazasi

bullets.text: Reanimatsiyadan so‘ng vazodilatatsiya bo‘ladi: qon oqimi mushak va jarohatlangan to‘qimaga ham ortadi.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

bullets.text: Kislorod sarfi va CO2 hosil bo‘lishi ortadi; tana taxikardiya va nafas tezlashuvi bilan javob beradi.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

bullets.text: Diqqat: asoratsiz holda bir necha kun; taxikardiya, harorat 4-5 kunda normallashmasa — asorat shubhasi.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nega oqim fazasida tomir ichi hajmini saqlash muhim? 2) Qaysi belgilar 4-5 kundan keyin ham saqlansa asoratni o‘ylatadi? Doskada: shok fazasidan oqim fazasiga o‘tish strelkasini chizing (vazokonstriksiya → vazodilatatsiya). Tipik xato: oqim fazasini patologiya deb o‘ylash — asoratsiz travmada u me’yoriy, faqat cho‘zilsa xavfli.

slides.title: Metabolik davrlar

bullets.text: Og‘ir travmadan so‘ng metabolizm avval bir necha soatdan 24 soatgacha pasayadi.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

bullets.text: Keyin gipermetabolik-katabolik faza: to‘qimalar parchalanadi, glyukoneogenez giperglikemiya beradi.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

bullets.text: Faza 1-2 haftadan oshsa — tizimli yallig‘lanish javobi sindromi (SIRS), infeksiya, sepsis shubhasi.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nega keksa va kasalliklari bor bemorlar yuqori kislorod talabiga bardosh bera olmaydi? 2) Giperglikemiya to‘qima oziqlanishida qanday rol o‘ynaydi? Doskada: vaqt o‘qida pasayish → gipermetabolizm chizig‘ini chizing. Tipik xato: dastlabki davrni ham yuqori metabolizm deb o‘ylash — u avval pasayadi.

slides.title: Immun javob davrlari: SIRS dan CARS gacha

bullets.text: Zarar molekulalari (DAMP) ajralib, steril tizimli yallig‘lanish sindromini (SIRS) boshlaydi.

source.author: Vourc'h et al.
source.title: Trauma-Induced Damage-Associated Molecular Patterns-Mediated Remote Organ Injury and Immunosuppression in the Acutely Ill Patient, Frontiers in Immunology

bullets.text: Dastlabki proyallig‘lanish tez orada kompensator yallig‘lanishga qarshi javob (CARS) bilan muvozanatlanadi.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

bullets.text: Travmadan 5-15 kun o‘tib CARS immunosupressiya va kasalxona infeksiyasi xavfini oshiradi.

source.author: Vourc'h et al.
source.title: Trauma-Induced Damage-Associated Molecular Patterns-Mediated Remote Organ Injury and Immunosuppression in the Acutely Ill Patient, Frontiers in Immunology

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 7 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nega dastlabki immunosupressiya foydali, lekin cho‘zilsa zararli? 2) Ikkinchi zarba (operatsiya) immun tizimga qanday ta’sir qiladi? Doskada: SIRS va CARS egri chiziqlarini bir o‘qda chizib, 5-15 kun oralig‘ini belgilang. Tipik xato: SIRS va CARS ni bir vaqtdagi emas, ketma-ket ikki alohida kasallik deb o‘ylash.

slides.title: O‘lim cho‘qqilari

bullets.text: Travmadan keyingi o‘limda uchta cho‘qqi bor: birinchi soat ichida, keyingi 24 soatda, kunlar–haftalardan keyin.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

bullets.text: 24 soatlik cho‘qqida qon ketishidan kelib chiqqan shok (gemorragik shok) o‘limga katta hissa qo‘shadi.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

bullets.text: SIRS — sistemali yallig‘lanish javob sindromi; MODS — ko‘p a’zo disfunksiyasi sindromi.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Muhokama: nima uchun birinchi soatda odamdagi yallig‘lanish javobi kam o‘rganilgan (qon namunasi olish qiyinligi)? Uchinchi cho‘qqi sabablari nimada? Doskada: vaqt o‘qini chizib, uch cho‘qqini belgilang. Tipik xato: uchala cho‘qqini ham faqat qon ketishi bilan bog‘lash; kech cho‘qqida ko‘pincha SIRS yoki MODS sabab bo‘ladi.

slides.title: Normallashish muddatlari

bullets.text: Odatda immun javob 2-kunda cho‘qqiga chiqib, 6–7 kunda asliga qaytadi deyiladi.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

bullets.text: Aslida javob uzoqroq davom etadi: neytrofillar apoptozining pasayishi 3 hafta saqlanadi.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

bullets.text: 3 haftagacha kutish g‘oyasi randomizatsiyalangan nazorat sinovlariga asoslanmagan.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 8 daq. Muhokama: nega bir ko‘rsatkich 1 haftada, boshqasi 3 haftada normallashadi? Tiklovchi jarrohlikni kechiktirish foydasi isbotlanganmi? Doskada: to‘rt ko‘rsatkich uchun muddatlar chizig‘ini chizing. Tipik xato: 6–7 kunni barcha immun ko‘rsatkichlar uchun umumiy muddat deb o‘ylash. MHCII — monotsitlardagi antigen taqdim etuvchi molekula (asosiy gistomoslik kompleksi 2).

slides.title: Voqea tahlili: 5-kunda ham taxikardiya

bullets.text: Vaziyat: og‘ir travmadan 5 kun o‘tgan, bemorda taxikardiya, tezlashgan nafas, leykotsitoz va yuqori harorat saqlanmoqda.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

bullets.text: Asoratsiz bemorda oqim fazasi (gipermetabolik faza) belgilari faqat bir necha kun davom etadi.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

bullets.text: Bu belgilar 4–5 kunda normallashmasa, asoratlar bo‘lishi mumkinligini o‘ylash kerak.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

bullets.text: Savol: yana qaysi belgi infeksiyani ko‘rsatadi? Javob: yallig‘lanish oqsillari va sitokinlarning ikkinchi cho‘qqisi.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 7 daq. Muhokama: oqim fazasida nima uchun yurak urishi va nafas tezlashadi (kislorod sarfi oshadi)? Bemorni kuzatishda qaysi ko‘rsatkichlarni tekshirasiz? Doskada: oqim fazasi belgilari va ‘4–5 kun’ chegarasini chizing. Tipik xato: taxikardiya va isitmani doim infeksiya deb hisoblash; avval muddatga qarang.

slides.title: Tezkor savol 2: davrlar

bullets.text: Shok fazasi: qon yo‘qotishdan gipovolemiya, periferik vazokonstriksiya, tuz va suv ushlanishi, qonning markaziy organlarga o‘tishi.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

bullets.text: Oqim fazasi: suyuqlik berilgach vazodilatatsiya, mushak va jarohatlangan to‘qimaga qon oqimi, kislorod sarfi va CO2 ishlab chiqarilishi ortadi.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

bullets.text: Metabolizm: dastlab bir necha soatdan 24 soatgacha pasayadi, so‘ng gipermetabolik va katabolik faza keladi; asoratsiz holda odatda bir haftadan qisqa.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

bullets.text: Diqqat: shok ≠ oqim fazasi. Shokda vazokonstriksiya, oqimda vazodilatatsiya; belgilar 4–5 kunda me’yorlashmasa, asorat shubhasi.

source.author: Brøchner et al.

Doskada: ikki ustunli (shok / oqim) taqqoslash jadvalini chizdiring. Tipik xato: talabalar shok va oqim fazalarini, shuningdek metabolik pasayish va gipermetabolik fazani bir-biriga aralashtiradi.

slides.title: Asosiy komponentlar: umumiy sxema

bullets.text: Yallig‘lanish javobi gormonal, metabolik va immunologik komponentlardan iborat; kengligi to‘qima shikasti hajmiga mos.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

bullets.text: Ularga gemodinamik javob qo‘shiladi; u ham metabolik va immun javob kabi ikki fazali.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

bullets.text: Neyroendokrin stress javobi immunologik javob bilan o‘zaro ta’sirlashadi.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nega bu javoblarni alohida emas, birgalikda baholash kerak? 2) Jarohat hajmi javob kuchiga qanday ta’sir qiladi? Doskada: to‘rt komponentni markazdagi jarohat atrofida o‘qlar bilan bog‘lab chizdiring. Tipik xato: komponentlarni ketma-ket emas, bir-biridan mustaqil deb o‘ylash; aslida ular o‘zaro ta’sirlashadi.

slides.title: Gormonal komponent

bullets.text: Jarohatdan keyin stress gormonlari ko‘payadi: adrenalin, kortizol, shuningdek glyukagon, o‘sish gormoni, aldosteron va antidiuretik gormon.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

bullets.text: Jarohat joyidan impulslar gipotalamus bo‘shatuvchi gormonlari va gipofizni qo‘zg‘atadi; kortizolni buyrak usti po‘stlog‘i, adrenalinni mag‘iz qavati chiqaradi.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

bullets.text: Gormonal javobning kuchi va davomiyligi jarohat hajmiga mos. Hayvonlarda estrogen himoya beradi; odamda ayol jinsi asoratlarni kamaytiradi.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

bullets.text: Diqqat: kuzatuv ≠ davo. Estrogen yoki gormon berish odamda natijani yaxshilashi isbotlanmagan.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Muhokama: 1) Jarohat joyidan buyrak usti bezigacha signal yo‘lini izohlang. 2) Nega ayol jinsining himoyasi estrogen davosini oqlamaydi? Doskada: jarohat → gipotalamus → gipofiz → buyrak usti bezi zanjirini chizdiring. Tipik xato: adrenalin po‘stloqdan, kortizol mag‘izdan chiqadi deb adashtirish.

slides.title: Gemodinamik komponent: mikrosirkulyatsiya

bullets.text: Shikastlangan to‘qimada mikrosirkulyatsiya xavf ostida bo‘ladi: sababi tomirlarning bevosita shikastlanishi yoki tromboz.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

bullets.text: To‘qimaning oziq moddalar bilan ta’minlanishi giperglikemiya yaratgan konsentratsiya gradiyentiga bog‘liq bo‘ladi.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

bullets.text: Mintaqaviy vazodilatatsiya bilan birga kapillyar sizish va mahalliy shish rivojlanadi.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

bullets.text: Qayta tomirlanish 3-7 kun ichida kechadi. Asoratsiz og‘ir travmada bir hafta ichida sizish, giperglikemiya va shish me’yorlashadi.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 4 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nega shikastlangan to‘qima oziqlanishi giperglikemiyaga bog‘liq? 2) Kapillyar sizish shishga qanday olib keladi? Doskada chizish: shikastlangan to‘qima kesimi: tomir, tromboz, sizish, shish va 3-7 kunlik qayta tomirlanish o‘qi. Tipik xato: qayta tomirlanish muddatini (3-7 kun) shok fazasi muddati bilan adashtirish.

bullets.text: Mahalliy vositachilar: kininlar, araxidon kislota metabolitlari va to‘qimadagi mast hujayralardan ajraluvchi gistamin.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

bullets.text: Ular kapillyar o‘tkazuvchanligini va shishni oshiradi, immun hujayralar infiltratsiyasini rag‘batlantiradi.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

bullets.text: Ta’siri uzoq, shuning uchun qondagi darajasi kam ahamiyatli.

source.author: Brøchner et al.

bullets.text: HMGB1 (yuqori harakatchan guruh oqsili-1) nekrotik hujayradan chiqib, neytrofil va makrofaglarni jalb qiladi, tomir sizishini oshiradi.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

bullets.text: Komplement kaskadi uch yo‘l bilan faollanadi va koagulyatsiya bilan bog‘liq: trombin komplementning C5a qismini faollashtiradi.

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 5 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nega mahalliy vositachilarni qon zardobida o‘lchash kam foyda beradi? 2) Koagulyatsiya va komplement qanday bog‘langan? Doskada chizish: trombin → C5a → immun javob zanjiri. Tipik xato: mahalliy vositachilar yarim yemirilishi qisqa bo‘lsa, ta’siri ham qisqa deb o‘ylash. Aslida ta’siri uzoq davom etadi.

slides.title: Sitokinlar zanjiri

bullets.text: O‘sma nekrozi omili (TNF-α) va interleykin-1 (IL-1) birinchi chiqadi; yarim yemirilishi 20 va 6 daqiqa.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

bullets.text: IL-6 bir soatda plazmada paydo bo‘ladi; jigarda C-reaktiv oqsil (CRP) va prokalsitonin sintezini oshiradi.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

bullets.text: IL-6 travma hajmi va asoratlar xavfi bilan bog‘liq; o‘tkir faza oqsillarining ikkinchi cho‘qqisi asoratni bildiradi.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 5 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nega TNF-α va IL-1 eng birinchi sitokinlar hisoblanadi? 2) Ikkinchi CRP cho‘qqisi klinik nimani bildiradi? Doskada chizish: TNF-α/IL-1 dan IL-6, IL-8, IL-10 ga o‘qlar. Tipik xato: IL-6 faqat yallig‘lanishni kuchaytiradi deb o‘ylash. U keyinchalik IL-10 orqali qarshi javobni ham qo‘zg‘atadi.

slides.title: Neytrofillar: ishga tushish va ko‘chib o‘tish

bullets.text: Neytrofillar jarohat joyiga birinchi yetib boradi; shu vaqtda qonda leykotsitoz ham kuzatiladi.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

bullets.text: Priming — dam olish va to‘liq faollik oralig‘idagi holat; ikkinchi zarba kuchliroq javob beradi.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

bullets.text: Faol neytrofillar sog‘ to‘qimani ham buzib, ARDS (o‘tkir respirator distress sindromi) xavfini oshiradi.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daqiqa. Muhokama: 1) Priming nima uchun ikkinchi zarbada xavfli? 2) Jarohatdan keyingi qaysi ikkinchi zarbalar neytrofillarni qayta qo‘zg‘atadi (operatsiya, kasalxona infeksiyasi)? Doskada: neytrofilning qon tomiridan to‘qimagacha yo‘lini 4 bosqichda chizdiring (priming, dumalash, qattiq yopishish, o‘tish). Tipik xato: priming ≠ to‘liq faollashuv; priming faqat oraliq tayyorgarlik holati. Diqqat: selektin dumalashga, integrin qattiq yopishishga javob beradi, bularni almashtirmang.

slides.title: Monotsitlar, NK va T-hujayralar

bullets.text: Monotsitlarda MHCII (gistomoslik kompleksi II) ifodasi pasayadi; bu jarohat hajmiga bog‘liq.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

bullets.text: Monotsit faolligi ikki fazali emas, uzluksiz pasayadi; sepsis xavfi bilan bog‘liq bo‘lishi mumkin.

source.author: Brøchner et al.

bullets.text: NK (natural killer) hujayralarda IFN-γ kamayishi Th2 ustunligiga olib keladi.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 7 daqiqa. Muhokama: 1) MHCII pasayishi nimani ko‘rsatadi va nega uni immun falaj belgisi deb olish mumkin? 2) Nega NK faolligining susayishi Th1/Th2 muvozanatiga ta’sir qiladi? Doskada: Th1 ← → Th2 tarozisini chizib, jarohatdan keyin Th2 tomonga og‘ishini ko‘rsating. Tipik xato: T-hujayralar kam ta’sirlanadi, shuning uchun ularni monotsit bilan bir xil darajada susayadi deb o‘ylash. Diqqat: monotsit uzluksiz susayadi, neytrofil esa faollashadi, bu ikkalasi bir vaqtda kuzatiladi.

slides.title: Voqea tahlili: sitokinlarning ikkinchi cho‘qqisi

bullets.text: Vaziyat: og‘ir jarohatdan keyin dastlabki soatlarda sitokinlar va o‘tkir faza oqsillari (masalan, C-reaktiv oqsil) yuqori bo‘ldi, so‘ng pasaydi.

source.author: Brøchner et al.

bullets.text: Ikkinchi cho‘qqi asorat, masalan infeksiya, borligini ko‘rsatishi mumkin; ikkinchi zarba operatsiya yoki kasalxona infeksiyasi bo‘lishi mumkin.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

bullets.text: Savol: ikkinchi cho‘qqi nimani anglatadi va asoratsiz kechishda sitokinlarga nima bo‘ladi?

source.author: Brøchner et al.

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 5 daqiqa. Javob: asoratsiz kechishda dastlabki yuqori sitokin va oqsil darajasi asta-sekin normallashadi va qarshi yallig‘lanish javobi bilan muvozanatlanadi; ikkinchi cho‘qqi infeksiya kabi asoratni shubha qildiradi. Muhokama: 1) Qanday ikkinchi zarbalar mumkin? 2) Nega yagona o‘lchov bemorning holatini to‘liq ko‘rsatmaydi? Doskada: vaqt o‘qida ikki cho‘qqili egri chiziq chizdiring. Tipik xato: ikkinchi cho‘qqini darhol normal tiklanish jarayoni deb hisoblash.

slides.title: DAMPs: ta’rifi va alarminlar

bullets.text: DAMPs — hujayra ichidagi yadro, mitoxondriya yoki sitozol molekulalari. Hujayradan tashqariga chiqsa, tug‘ma va adaptiv immunitetni faollashtiradi.

source.author: Vourc'h et al.

bullets.text: Dendritik hujayralar va neytrofillar DAMPsni tanish retseptorlari (PRR, pattern recognition receptors) orqali taniydi.

source.author: Vourc'h et al.
source.title: Trauma-Induced Damage-Associated Molecular Patterns-Mediated Remote Organ Injury and Immunosuppression in the Acutely Ill Patient, Frontiers in Immunology

bullets.text: Keyin sitokin va xemokinlar ishlab chiqariladi.

source.author: Vourc'h et al.
source.title: Trauma-Induced Damage-Associated Molecular Patterns-Mediated Remote Organ Injury and Immunosuppression in the Acutely Ill Patient, Frontiers in Immunology

bullets.text: Travmadan keyin chiqqan DAMPs alarminlar deb ham ataladi.

source.author: Vourc'h et al.

bullets.text: Mahalliy yallig‘lanish to‘qima tiklanishiga xizmat qiladi, nazoratsiz bo‘lsa uzoq a’zolar yetishmovchiligini keltiradi.

Doskada: hujayra → DAMP → PRR → sitokin zanjirini chizing. Tipik xato: DAMPs (o‘z molekulalari) va PAMPs (mikrob molekulalari) ni aralashtirish; ikkalasi o‘xshash yallig‘lanish keltirishi mumkin, ammo manbasi boshqa. 2006 yilgi konsensusga ko‘ra klinik alarmin travmadan darhol chiqadi, miqdori jarohat og‘irligini aks ettiradi va plazma darajasi yallig‘lanish bilan bog‘liq.

Doskada: jadvalni daftarga ko‘chirib, har DAMP uchun bitta klinik bog‘lanishni belgilang. Tipik xato: barcha DAMPs yomon oqibatni bildiradi deb o‘ylash — HSP72 da aksi kuzatilgan.

slides.title: DAMPs retseptorlari va signal yo‘llari

bullets.text: TLR (toll-like retseptor) yuzada, NLR (NOD-like) ichkarida; NF-κB (yadro omili κB) yo‘lini ishga soladi.

Doskada: DAMP → retseptor → adapter → transkripsiya omili → sitokin zanjirini chizing. Tipik xato: barcha TLR MyD88 orqali ishlaydi deb o‘ylash — TLR3 faqat TRIF yo‘lini ishlatadi; sxema soddalashtirilgan.

bullets.text: Savol 2: RAGE (ilg‘or glikatsiya mahsulotlari retseptori) bilan TLR (toll-simon retseptor) farqi nimada?

source.title: Trauma-Induced Damage-Associated Molecular Patterns-Mediated Remote Organ Injury and Immunosuppression in the Acutely Ill Patient, Frontiers in Immunology

bullets.text: Diqqat: xato qilish xavfi — TLR ≠ RAGE. TLR mikrob andozalarini (PAMP) ham, DAMPni ham taniydi; RAGE faqat DAMPga xos, PAMP bilan faollashmaydi.

Tipik xato: RAGEni ham mikroblarni taniydigan retseptor deb o‘ylash va alarminlarni faqat bitta molekula deb tushunish.

Doskada: zanjir chizdiring — shikast → DAMP ajralishi → HLA-DR pasayishi → immunosupressiya → infeksiya. Tipik xato: bog‘liqlikni (korrelyatsiya) bevosita sabab deb talqin qilish.

mcq.question: Bemor kichik to‘qima jarohati oldi. Jarohatga javoban har doim qaysi reaksiya kuzatiladi?
options: Immun falaj va ikkilamchi infeksiya rivojlanishi
Sepsis bilan kechuvchi ko‘p a’zo disfunksiyasi
mcq.explanation: Har qanday to‘qima shikastida mahalliy yallig‘lanish javobi doim bo‘ladi. Tizimli javob faqat og‘ir yoki ko‘p jarohatda qo‘shiladi.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

mcq.question: Asoratsiz travmada tizimli yallig‘lanish javobi qanday xususiyatga ega?
options: Doimiy, oldindan aytib bo‘lmaydigan, faqat yallig‘lantiruvchi
Faqat yallig‘lanishga qarshi mediatorlar hisobiga kechadi
Faqat og‘ir jarohatda chiqadi va doim zararli bo‘ladi
mcq.explanation: Asoratsiz jarohatda javob vaqtinchalik, bashorat qilinadigan va yallig‘lantiruvchi hamda yallig‘lanishga qarshi mediatorlar orasida muvozanatli bo‘ladi. U to‘qima tiklanishi uchun zarur.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

mcq.question: Og‘ir travma olgan bemorga zudlik bilan zarur shikastni nazorat qilish jarrohligi (damage-control) o‘tkazildi. Ko‘p zarba nazariyasida bu jarrohlik nima hisoblanadi?
mcq.explanation: Birinchi zarba travmaning o‘zi, ikkinchisi zarur damage-control jarrohligi. Takroriy zarbalar immun tizimni charchatib, infeksiya va sepsis xavfini oshirishi mumkin.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

mcq.question: Bemor reanimatsiyada barqarorlashtirilmoqda, yakuniy tiklovchi jarrohlik kechiktirilmoqda. Qaysi uchlik xavfdan saqlanish ko‘zda tutiladi?
mcq.explanation: Yakuniy jarrohlik gipotermiya, atsidoz va koagulopatiyadan iborat zararli uchlikdan hamda immun tizimga yana bir zarbadan saqlanish uchun kechiktiriladi.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

mcq.question: Travmadan 10 kun o‘tgach bemorda dastlabki yallig‘lanish pasaydi, ammo kasalxona pnevmoniyasi rivojlandi. Bu qaysi davrga mos keladi?
options: Dastlabki shok fazasi va periferik vazokonstriksiya
Kompensator yallig‘lanishga qarshi javob va immunosupressiya
Erta steril SIRS va undan kelgan a’zo yetishmovchiligi
mcq.explanation: Erta bosqichda SIRS a’zo yetishmovchiligiga olib keladi. Travmadan taxminan 5-15 kun o‘tgach CARS immunosupressiyani keltirib chiqaradi va nozokomial infeksiyaga moyillikni oshiradi.

source.author: Vourc'h et al.
source.title: Trauma-Induced Damage-Associated Molecular Patterns-Mediated Remote Organ Injury and Immunosuppression in the Acutely Ill Patient, Frontiers in Immunology

mcq.question: Qon yo‘qotgan, hali infuziya olmagan bemorda shok fazasining qaysi gemodinamik belgisi kutiladi?
options: Perifer vazokonstriksiya, qonning markaziy a’zolarga ko‘chishi
Perifer vazodilatatsiya, mushak va jarohatga qon oqimi ortishi
Kislorod iste’moli va CO2 hosil bo‘lishining kuchli ortishi
Natriy va suv chiqib ketishi, qon bosimining ko‘tarilishi
mcq.explanation: Shok fazasida gemorragiya gipovolemiya chaqiradi. Bunda perifer vazokonstriksiya, natriy xlorid va suvning ushlanishi hamda qonning periferiyadan markaziy hayotiy a’zolarga ko‘chishi kuzatiladi. Vazodilatatsiya va oqim ortishi esa suyuqlik bilan reanimatsiyadan keyingi oqim (flow) fazasiga xos.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

mcq.question: Og‘ir travmadan 5 kun o‘tgach bemorda taxikardiya, tezlashgan nafas, leykotsitoz va isitma saqlanmoqda. Qanday xulosa to‘g‘ri?
options: Bu normal oqim fazasi, faqat kuzatishning o‘zi yetarli
Gormonal davo natijani yaxshilashi isbotlangan, uni boshlash kerak
Shok fazasi qaytadan boshlangan, vazokonstriksiya kutiladi
Asoratlar, masalan infeksiya, bo‘lishi mumkinligi shubha qilinadi
mcq.explanation: Asoratsiz travmada oqim fazasi belgilari bir necha kun davom etadi. Taxikardiya, tezlashgan nafas, leykotsitoz va harorat 4-5 kun ichida normallashmasa, asoratlar shubha qilinadi. Odamlarda gormonal davo natijani yaxshilashi isbotlanmagan.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

mcq.question: Shifokor rekonstruktiv operatsiyadan oldin neytrofillar apoptozi kamayishining ham tiklanishini kutmoqchi. Taxminan qancha kutiladi?
options: Taxminan 1 hafta, MHCII ekspressiyasi tiklanishi bilan
Taxminan 2 hafta, oksidlovchi portlash tiklanishi bilan
Taxminan 3 hafta, neytrofil apoptozi tiklanishi bilan
Taxminan 6 soat, oksidlovchi portlash cho‘qqisi bilan
mcq.explanation: Asoratsiz travmada monotsitlarda MHCII taxminan 1 haftada normallashadi. Neytrofillar apoptozining kamayishi esa 3 hafta davom etadi. Immun tizim normallashishi talab qilinsa, operatsiya 3 haftaga qoldirilardi. Bu yondashuv randomizatsiyalangan sinovlarga asoslanmagan.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

mcq.question: Travmadan keyingi o‘limning ikkinchi cho‘qqisiga (dastlabki 24 soat) eng katta hissa qo‘shadigan holat qaysi?
mcq.explanation: Travmada o‘lim uch cho‘qqiga ega: birinchi soat ichida, keyingi 24 soat ichida va kunlar-haftalardan so‘ng. Ikkinchi cho‘qqida gemorragik shok yuqori o‘limga sezilarli hissa qo‘shadi. Uchinchi cho‘qqida sabab ko‘pincha SIRS yoki MODS bo‘ladi.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

mcq.question: Dastlabki SIRS (tizimli yallig‘lanish javobi sindromi)dan keyin CARS (kompensator yallig‘lanishga qarshi javob sindromi) travmadan qancha vaqt o‘tgach rivojlanadi?
mcq.explanation: Erta bosqichda yallig‘lanish javobi a’zolar yetishmovchiligiga olib kelishi mumkin. Travmadan 5-15 kun o‘tgach CARS rivojlanib, immunosupressiya va nozokomial infeksiyaga moyillikni oshiradi.

source.author: Vourc'h et al.
source.title: Trauma-Induced Damage-Associated Molecular Patterns-Mediated Remote Organ Injury and Immunosuppression in the Acutely Ill Patient, Frontiers in Immunology

mcq.question: Bemor og‘ir travmadan keyin ikki haftadan ortiq giper metabolik holatda turibdi. Bu holatda nimadan shubhalanish kerak?
options: Og‘ir SIRS va yashirin infeksiya yoki sepsis
mcq.explanation: Asoratsiz og‘ir travmada giper metabolik faza odatda bir haftadan kam davom etadi. Agar u 1-2 haftadan oshsa, og‘ir sistemali yallig‘lanish javobi (SIRS) rivojlangan bo‘lishi mumkin. Shunda yashirin infeksiya va sepsisni ham o‘ylash kerak.

source.author: Brøchner et al.
source.title: Pathophysiology of the systemic inflammatory response after major accidental trauma, Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine

mcq.question: Reperfuziya shikastida neytrofillar uzoq a’zolardan qaysilarda ko‘proq to‘planadi?
options: Taloq, qalqonsimon bez va oshqozon osti bezi
Yurak, suyak iligi va limfa tugunlari
mcq.explanation: Reperfuziya neytrofillarning zararlangan to‘qimada ham, uzoq a’zolarda ham (buyrak, jigar, o‘pka) to‘planishini chaqiradi; bu a’zolarda neytrofillar va MPO ko‘p topiladi.

mcq.question: Travmadan keyin plazmada bir soat ichida aniqlanadigan va jigarda o‘tkir faza oqsillari (CRP) sintezini qo‘zg‘atadigan sitokin qaysi?
mcq.explanation: IL-6 travmadan keyin bir soat ichida plazmada aniqlanadi va jigarda CRP hamda prokaltsitonin sintezini rag‘batlantiradi. IL-1 isitma chaqiradi, IL-8 neytrofillarni shikast joyiga tortadi, IL-10 esa yallig‘lanishga qarshi sitokindir.

mcq.question: Travma joyida neytrofil qon tomir devori bo‘ylab dumalab, so‘ng to‘xtab, mustahkam yopishdi. Aynan shu mustahkam yopishishni qaysi molekulalar ta’minlaydi?
mcq.explanation: Neytrofil ko‘chib o‘tishi uch bosqichda kechadi: dumalash, to‘xtash va to‘qimaga o‘tish. Dumalashda selektinlar (CD62L) qatnashadi, mustahkam yopishishni esa integrinlar (CD11b/CD18) ta’minlaydi.

mcq.question: Travmadan keyin sitokinlar va o‘tkir faza oqsillarining yuqori darajasi pasaydi, keyin qonda ularning ikkinchi cho‘qqisi aniqlandi. Bu nimani anglatishi mumkin?
mcq.explanation: Dastlabki yuqori sitokin darajasi asta-sekin me’yorlashadi va yallig‘lanishga qarshi javob bilan muvozanatlanadi. Ikkinchi cho‘qqi aniqlansa, infeksiya kabi asoratdan shubhalanish kerak.

mcq.question: 2006-yilgi konsensusga ko‘ra, travmada klinik ahamiyatli alarmin qaysi belgi bilan ta’riflanadi?
mcq.explanation: Konsensusga ko‘ra klinik ahamiyatli alarmin travmadan keyin darhol ajraladi. Uning miqdori travma og‘irligini va yallig‘lanish darajasini aks ettiradi. Mikrob mahsulotlari PAMP deyiladi, alarminlar esa organizmning o‘z molekulalaridir.

mcq.question: Travmadan keyin bemor plazmasida yadro DNK va HSP70 (issiqlik zarbi oqsili 70) darajasi yuqori. Monotsitlardagi HLA-DR ifodasi qanday o‘zgaradi?
mcq.explanation: Timmermans tadqiqotida (166 bemor) yadro DNK va HSP70 darajasi HLA-DR ifodasi bilan teskari bog‘langan. Yadro DNK yuqori bo‘lib HLA-DR yanada pasaygan bemorlarda infeksiya ko‘proq uchragan. Bu DAMPlarning postravmatik immunosupressiyadagi rolini ko‘rsatadi.

mcq.question: Og‘ir travmali bemorda gipotermiya, atsidoz va koagulopatiya bor. Birinchi kunda qaysi taktika to‘g‘ri?
options: Gormonal davo asosiy usul sifatida tanlanadi
mcq.explanation: Birinchi kuni jarrohlik nazoratli (damage control) bo‘ladi: uzun suyak sinishini stabillash, dekompressiya, debridment. Bu gipotermiya, atsidoz va koagulopatiya uchligini hamda yana bir yallig‘lanish zarbasini oldini oladi. Hayotni saqlovchi aralashuvlar kechiktirilmaydi, gormonal davoning foydasi isbotlanmagan.

source.author: Brøchner et al.

mcq.question: Travmadan 8 kun o‘tgach bemorda kasalxona pnevmoniyasi rivojlanib, organ yetishmovchiligi boshlandi. Kech MODS (ko‘p organ disfunksiyasi sindromi) asosiy sababi nima?
mcq.explanation: Erta MODS odatda nazoratsiz SIRS bilan bog‘liq. Kech MODSda esa immunosupressiya tufayli nozokomial infeksiyalar, asosan pnevmoniya, asosiy rol o‘ynaydi. Kompensator yallig‘lanishga qarshi javob (CARS) travmadan 5–15 kun o‘tgach rivojlanadi.

source.author: Vourc'h et al.
source.title: Trauma-Induced Damage-Associated Molecular Patterns-Mediated Remote Organ Injury and Immunosuppression in the Acutely Ill Patient, Frontiers in Immunology

mcq.question: Ko‘p travmali bemorga massiv qon quyildi. Gemolizga uchragan eritrotsitlar qaysi molekulani DAMP sifatida qon oqimiga chiqaradi?
mcq.explanation: Gemolizlangan eritrotsitlar qon oqimiga ko‘p DAMP chiqaradi: gem, HSP70, RBP-4, IL-33, S100 oqsillari va adenozin. Gem TLR4 orqali makrofaglarda inflammasoma hosil bo‘lishini kuchaytiradi. Glyukagon, aldosteron va kortizol esa stress gormonlari bo‘lib, DAMP emas.

extras.text: Travmadan keyin o‘lim uch cho‘qqi beradi: birinchi soat ichida, keyingi 24 soatda (gemorragik shok katta rol o‘ynaydi) va kunlar yoki haftalar o‘tib (ko‘pincha SIRS yoki MODS sabab bo‘ladi). Eslab qolish usuli: «1 soat – 24 soat – kunlar/haftalar». SIRS – tizimli yallig‘lanish javobi sindromi, MODS – ko‘p a’zolar disfunksiyasi sindromi.

Yakuniy tiklovchi operatsiya ko‘pincha kechiktiriladi, chunki gipotermiya, atsidoz va koagulopatiya xavfli uchligi hamda immun tizimga yangi zarba oldini olinadi. extras.text: Gemodinamik javob ikki fazali. Shok fazasida qon tomirlar toraygan bo‘ladi, qon markaziy a’zolarga o‘tadi. Suyuqlik bilan reanimatsiyadan keyin oqim (giperметаболик) fazasi boshlanadi: tomirlar kengayadi, kislorod sarfi oshadi. Taxikardiya, tez nafas olish, leykotsitoz va harorat 4–5 kunda me’yorlashmasa, asoratdan shubha qilinadi.

extras.text: DAMPs – shikastlangan to‘qimalardan qonga chiqadigan hujayra ichidagi molekulalar. Ular avval sterril SIRS va a’zolar yetishmovchiligini keltiradi. Keyin, taxminan 5–15-kunlarda, CARS orqali immunosupressiya rivojlanadi va kasalxona infeksiyalari, asosan pnevmoniya xavfi oshadi. Diqqat: SIRS (yallig‘lanish) ≠ CARS (yallig‘lanishga qarshi javob).
